paragraphs.heading: F-16 Nose Landing Gear
paragraphs.text: Interactive Electronic Technical Manual (IETM) for the F-16 nose landing gear assembly. The manual combines descriptive data, an interactive Illustrated Parts Data (IPD) module and step-by-step procedures, all linked to the 3D model.

paragraphs.heading: How to use
paragraphs.text: Select a data module in the publication tree. Click a part in the 3D view or a row in the parts list to cross-highlight it. Use the viewer toolbar to isolate, hide, x-ray or explode the assembly. Add parts to the order list with the cart button.

paragraphs.heading: Printable Illustrated Parts Catalog
paragraphs.text: 32-20-00 Figure 1 - title page, assembly, exploded view, three detail sheets and the full parts list (7 pages, PDF).

paragraphs.heading: Data status
paragraphs.text: This is a proof-of-concept publication. Part numbers, CAGE codes and procedures are sample data.

paragraphs.heading: General
paragraphs.text: The nose landing gear supports the forward fuselage on the ground, steers the aircraft during taxi and retracts forward into the nose gear bay in flight. Select a heading to isolate that subassembly in the 3D view: it keeps its own colours and the rest of the gear turns transparent.

paragraphs.heading: Strut and swivel
paragraphs.text: The strut housing (10) carries the trunnion. The main swivel arm (20) and strut collar (30) let the strut rotate during retraction.

paragraphs.heading: Steering
paragraphs.text: The steering assembly (40) transfers servo input through the servo link (90), the upper and lower steering links (70, 80) and the steering top head (60) to the steering collar (50).

paragraphs.heading: Retraction
paragraphs.text: The retraction actuator (110) drives the main and secondary actuator arms (120, 130). The gear rotation link (150) swings the strut forward while the folding drag brace (160) - inner and outer arms, pivot and fork (210) - breaks over-centre.

paragraphs.heading: Wheel
paragraphs.text: The wheel (230) runs on the hub (220).

steps.title: Retraction - overview
steps.text: When the gear handle is set UP, the retraction actuator drives the linkage and the gear swings forward and up into the nose gear bay. The animation plays the full cycle (extend - retract) in a loop. Use Next to follow each stage; the parts that do the work stay in colour.

steps.title: 1. The actuator lead screw turns
steps.text: The drive in the retraction actuator turns the lead screw (piston rod, 115). The screw runs through the actuator nut (140) and is the first moving part of the sequence.

steps.title: 2. The gear actuator moves
steps.text: As the screw turns, the actuator nut (140) travels along it and the retraction actuator (110) changes length. The actuator body pivots on its mount to follow the linkage.

steps.title: 3. The actuator arms rotate the main swivel arm
steps.text: The main and secondary actuator arms (120, 130) turn the actuation into rotation of the main swivel arm (20). The swivel arm carries the strut, so the whole gear starts to swing forward and up.

steps.title: 4. Steering turns the wheel to fit the bay
steps.text: While the gear swings, the gear rotation link (150) and the steering assembly - servo link (90), top head (60), steering collar (50) and the upper and lower steering links (70, 80) - turn the strut and wheel (230) so the wheel lines up with the nose gear bay.

steps.title: 5. The drag brace folds
steps.text: At the same time the folding drag brace - inner arm (170), outer arm (180), pivot (190) and fork (210) - unlocks and folds, so the strut can swing up. When the gear extends the brace opens again and locks over-centre to hold the gear down.

steps.title: Gear up and locked
steps.text: The gear is stowed in the bay. Extension is the same sequence in reverse: the brace opens and locks, the steering re-centres the wheel and the actuator drives the gear down and locked.

steps.title: Preliminary requirements
steps.text: Gear extended, safety pins installed, hydraulic and electrical power off. The removed parts are laid out next to the assembly in the order they come off - nothing overlaps.
steps.warning: WARNING: Make sure the aircraft is safely supported on jacks before you disassemble the nose landing gear.

steps.title: 1. Remove the nose wheel
steps.text:
Remove the axle nut and slide the wheel off the axle.

Part details:
• Item 230 · Wheel - Nose, Tire · P/N NLG-32-1430-01 - Carries the aircraft weight on the ground and rolls on the hub. Tubeless tyre on a split wheel.

steps.title: 2. Remove the upper steering link
steps.text:
Remove the pin at the steering collar and take off the upper link.

Part details:
• Item 70 · Link - Steering, Upper · P/N NLG-32-1130-01 - Upper half of the steering (torque) link: keeps the wheel aligned with the steering collar while the shock strut compresses.

steps.title: 3. Remove the lower steering link
steps.text:
Remove the pin at the lower strut and take off the lower link.

Part details:
• Item 80 · Link - Steering, Lower · P/N NLG-32-1140-01 - Lower half of the steering (torque) link: joins the upper link to the lower strut so steering input reaches the wheel.

steps.title: 4. Remove the wheel hub / lower strut
steps.text:
Slide the lower strut and hub down out of the collars and put it on a padded stand.

Part details:
• Item 220 · Hub - Wheel · P/N NLG-32-1420-02 - Lower strut and hub: absorbs landing loads and carries the wheel axle.

steps.title: 5. Remove the actuator nut
steps.text:
Turn the nut off the end of the lead screw.

Part details:
• Item 140 · Nut - Actuator · P/N NLG-32-1240-01 - Rides on the lead screw and turns its rotation into the linear travel that drives the actuator arms.

steps.title: 6. Remove the main and secondary actuator arms
steps.text:
Remove the pins and take off both actuator arms together.

Part details:
• Item 120 · Arm - Actuator, Main · P/N NLG-32-1220-01 - Main actuator arm: transmits the actuator force to the main swivel arm.
• Item 130 · Arm - Actuator, Secondary · P/N NLG-32-1230-01 - Secondary actuator arm: links the actuator nut to the main actuator arm.

steps.title: 7. Remove the retraction actuator
steps.text:
Disconnect the actuator mounts and remove the actuator with its lead screw.

Part details:
• Item 110 · Actuator - Gear Retraction · P/N NLG-32-1210-04 - Gear retraction actuator: drives the gear up and down.
• Item 115 · Rod - Piston, Gear Actuator · P/N NLG-32-1215-01 - Lead screw (piston rod) inside the actuator: its rotation moves the actuator nut.

steps.title: 8. Remove the inner arm pivot
steps.text:
Pull the pivot pin out of the inner folding arm.

Part details:
• Item 190 · Pivot - Inner Arm · P/N NLG-32-1330-01 - Hinge pin of the drag-brace inner arm on the gear structure.

steps.title: 9. Remove the fork fitting
steps.text:
Remove the fork fitting from the linkage.

Part details:
• Item 210 · Fork - Wheel · P/N NLG-32-1410-01 - Fork fitting: clevis that carries the drag-brace / linkage pin.

steps.title: 10. Remove the drag brace (outer and inner folding arms)
steps.text:
Remove the drag brace pins and take off the outer and inner folding arms together.

Part details:
• Item 180 · Arm - Folding, Outer · P/N NLG-32-1320-01 - Outer folding arm of the drag brace: connects the brace to the strut.
• Item 170 · Arm - Folding, Inner · P/N NLG-32-1310-01 - Inner folding arm of the drag brace: locks over-centre to hold the gear down, folds for retraction.

steps.title: 11. Remove the steering collar
steps.text:
Slide the steering collar down off its seat.

Part details:
• Item 50 · Collar - Steering · P/N NLG-32-1110-02 - Steering collar: turns around the strut and passes the steering input to the torque links.

steps.title: 12. Remove the strut collar
steps.text:
Slide the strut collar down out of the swivel arm.

Part details:
• Item 30 · Collar - Strut · P/N NLG-32-1030-01 - Strut collar: holds the strut in the swivel arm and takes radial loads.

steps.title: 13. Remove the gear rotation link
steps.text:
Remove the pins and take out the gear rotation link.

Part details:
• Item 150 · Link - Gear Rotation · P/N NLG-32-1250-02 - Gear rotation link: turns the strut during retraction so the wheel fits the bay.

steps.title: 14. Remove the steering servo link
steps.text:
Disconnect the servo link from the steering head.

Part details:
• Item 90 · Link - Steering Servo · P/N NLG-32-1150-01 - Steering servo link: connects the nose wheel steering servo to the steering head.

steps.title: 15. Remove the main swivel arm
steps.text:
Remove the trunnion bolts and lower the main swivel arm out of the housing.

Part details:
• Item 20 · Arm - Swivel, Main · P/N NLG-32-1020-03 - Main swivel arm (trunnion): carries the strut in the housing and pivots during retraction.

steps.title: 16. Remove the steering top head
steps.text:
Lift the steering top head out of the swivel arm.

Part details:
• Item 60 · Head - Steering, Top · P/N NLG-32-1120-01 - Steering top head: receives the servo input at the top of the strut.

steps.title: Disassembly complete
steps.text: All 16 removal steps are done. Only the strut housing (10) stays on the aircraft. Examine all parts for wear, corrosion and damage before you assemble the gear.

steps.title: Preliminary requirements
steps.text: All parts cleaned, examined and serviceable, laid out next to the strut housing. Assembly is the disassembly in reverse order.
steps.caution: CAUTION: Use new seals and cotter pins. Lubricate the pins and bushings before you install them.

steps.title: 1. Install the steering top head
steps.text:
Put the steering top head back in position and install its pins and fasteners.

Part details:
• Item 60 · Head - Steering, Top · P/N NLG-32-1120-01 - Steering top head: receives the servo input at the top of the strut.

steps.title: 2. Install the main swivel arm
steps.text:

• Item 90 · Link - Steering Servo · P/N NLG-32-1150-01 - Steering servo link: connects the nose wheel steering servo to the steering head.

steps.title: 7. Install the drag brace (outer and inner folding arms)
steps.text:
Put the drag brace (outer and inner folding arms) back in position and install its pins and fasteners.

Part details:
• Item 180 · Arm - Folding, Outer · P/N NLG-32-1320-01 - Outer folding arm of the drag brace: connects the brace to the strut.
• Item 170 · Arm - Folding, Inner · P/N NLG-32-1310-01 - Inner folding arm of the drag brace: locks over-centre to hold the gear down, folds for retraction.

steps.title: 8. Install the fork fitting
steps.text:
Put the fork fitting back in position and install its pins and fasteners.

Part details:
• Item 210 · Fork - Wheel · P/N NLG-32-1410-01 - Fork fitting: clevis that carries the drag-brace / linkage pin.

steps.title: 9. Install the inner arm pivot
steps.text:
Put the inner arm pivot back in position and install its pins and fasteners.

Part details:
• Item 190 · Pivot - Inner Arm · P/N NLG-32-1330-01 - Hinge pin of the drag-brace inner arm on the gear structure.

steps.title: 10. Install the retraction actuator
steps.text:
Put the retraction actuator back in position and install its pins and fasteners.

Part details:
• Item 110 · Actuator - Gear Retraction · P/N NLG-32-1210-04 - Gear retraction actuator: drives the gear up and down.
• Item 115 · Rod - Piston, Gear Actuator · P/N NLG-32-1215-01 - Lead screw (piston rod) inside the actuator: its rotation moves the actuator nut.

steps.title: 11. Install the main and secondary actuator arms
steps.text:
Put the main and secondary actuator arms back in position and install its pins and fasteners.

Part details:
• Item 120 · Arm - Actuator, Main · P/N NLG-32-1220-01 - Main actuator arm: transmits the actuator force to the main swivel arm.
• Item 130 · Arm - Actuator, Secondary · P/N NLG-32-1230-01 - Secondary actuator arm: links the actuator nut to the main actuator arm.

steps.title: 12. Install the actuator nut
steps.text:
Put the actuator nut back in position and install its pins and fasteners.

Part details:
• Item 140 · Nut - Actuator · P/N NLG-32-1240-01 - Rides on the lead screw and turns its rotation into the linear travel that drives the actuator arms.

steps.title: 13. Install the wheel hub / lower strut
steps.text:
Put the wheel hub / lower strut back in position and install its pins and fasteners.

Part details:
• Item 220 · Hub - Wheel · P/N NLG-32-1420-02 - Lower strut and hub: absorbs landing loads and carries the wheel axle.

steps.title: 14. Install the lower steering link
steps.text:
Put the lower steering link back in position and install its pins and fasteners.

Part details:
• Item 80 · Link - Steering, Lower · P/N NLG-32-1140-01 - Lower half of the steering (torque) link: joins the upper link to the lower strut so steering input reaches the wheel.

steps.title: 15. Install the upper steering link
steps.text:
Put the upper steering link back in position and install its pins and fasteners.

Part details:
• Item 70 · Link - Steering, Upper · P/N NLG-32-1130-01 - Upper half of the steering (torque) link: keeps the wheel aligned with the steering collar while the shock strut compresses.

steps.title: 16. Install the nose wheel
steps.text:
Put the nose wheel back in position and install its pins and fasteners.

Part details:
• Item 230 · Wheel - Nose, Tire · P/N NLG-32-1430-01 - Carries the aircraft weight on the ground and rolls on the hub. Tubeless tyre on a split wheel.

steps.title: Assembly complete
steps.text: The nose landing gear is assembled. Do the retraction functional test before flight.

steps.title: Preparation
steps.text: Put the aircraft on jacks. Make sure that the nose gear bay is clear of people and equipment.
steps.warning: WARNING: Keep clear of the gear bay during retraction. The moving parts can cause serious injury.

steps.title: Down-lock check
steps.text: Make sure that the folding drag brace (160) is over-centre and the actuator (110) is fully extended.

steps.title: Retract the gear
steps.text: Operate the retraction actuator. The gear rotation link (150) swings the strut forward into the bay. Watch for interference.

steps.title: Extend the gear
steps.text: Extend the gear. Make sure that the drag brace locks over-centre and that the indicator shows down and locked.

steps.title: Close-up
steps.text: Remove the jacks and the safety pins after the test is complete.
